user.title: What do you want to follow?
user.description: A departure board shows everything leaving a stop. A trip shows only the departures that take you to your destination, changes included.

menu_options.trip: A trip from A to B

departures.title: Choose a stop or station
departures.description:
Type the name of a bus stop, tram stop, station, pier or cable car station anywhere in Switzerland.

Optional: a free key from opentransportdata.swiss (API "OJP 2.0") adds real-time data for buses and trams, cancellations and disruption messages. Without a key, the timetable comes from transport.opendata.ch with real-time delays mostly for trains.

filters.title: Departures from {stop}
filters.description: Everything is optional. Leave empty to see every departure.

data_description.lines: Comma separated, e.g. 9, 21, S3. Empty for all lines.
data_description.destination: Only departures whose destination contains this text, e.g. Genève.
data_description.walk_time: Hides departures you can no longer reach.

trip.title: Your trip
trip.description:
Type where you leave from and where you go. The integration finds the next connections, with changes and arrival time.

Optional: a free key from opentransportdata.swiss (API "OJP 2.0") adds real-time data for buses and trams, cancellations and disruption messages.

data_description.walk_time: Hides departures you can no longer reach.

reauth_confirm.description: opentransportdata.swiss refused the API key. Enter a new one, or leave empty to use the free source without key.
